criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Two frames are genuinely good and the weak two are the cover and the close. Frame 5 is real isotype discipline, 8 by 5 at one width, separable at contact sheet scale. Frame 6 puts a true scale figure against an enclosure that bleeds both edges. One declared light is held on all nine frames and every cast runs down and right. Against it, frame 1 still fails the primary image test, the machines, pad and right edge slab reading as one continuous hatch mass over the bottom 45 percent, with the only high contrast marks being the DARK louvre bars, so the eye lands on the opposite of the declared focal. Frame 9's floor carries no falloff from its own declared source and its amber notice has a hard offset drop shadow. Frame 7's content occupies 17 percent of the height and the bright pad below it is the largest bright area, refuting its own value plan.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The unity is real and is this deck's best structural property: one ground, one line screen at one cell, one light with every cast down and right, one type system and one furniture strip through all nine. What holds it at 7 is that only one of three declared devices does real work. The measured track spans 3.8 L* across frames 4 to 9, which is a floor and not an arc; the edge tease is nominal; motif evolution works on 2, 5 and 6 and breaks on 1 and 9, the two frames where it matters most.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Checked by hand against claims.json and figures.json. Every numeral on every frame traces, and so do the caption's seven. All 22 claims carry a verbatim quote, a URL, a source title and a retrieved date. The rejected list is the strongest thing in this package: six findings refused by name, including the deck's original mechanism and its original closing frame. The deck nowhere says the agency has halted anything and frame 8 refuses both readings of the Odessa contract. Held off 9 because this run's committed files repeatedly asserted figures its own data refuted and every one was found by a reader rather than a check.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The argument is sharp and non obvious, documented rather than inferred, with three releases confining the audit to the queue in three phrasings. Frame 8 exists purely to kill a wrong reading, which most decks would cut. Against the 9, a reader's next step is absent, honestly rather than carelessly, and permits stays abstract across nine frames.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The middle is good and both ends are weak, which is the worst distribution. The cover does not earn a swipe on its art, only on its type, and the close does not land because the flattest frame in the deck arrives when the argument is supposed to shut.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, plain, confident, no boosterism and no doom. House rules checked by hand across all nine frames and the caption with no breach. Held at 7 because it is flat and institutional where it counts on numbers, and because the regional specificity is naming rather than register.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Visually distinct and genuinely so: a line screen at cell 6 against three other stocks, a ground at dE76 24.54 from its nearest measurable neighbour, and a cover that opens on a machine rather than an absence, which six consecutive run records asked for in capitals. Against it, the subject and the instrument repeat, and it is the fifth interconnection deck inside the window.

one_sentence_fix: Give frame 1's two near sets a mark the pad does not have, a heavier contour weight or a screen angle change across the figure and ground boundary, and widen the frame's median band to the deck's own measured floor so the pad can drop under them, because the cover's mass is a figure and ground failure of MATERIAL rather than of value and no median preserving value move fixes it.
